name: Solar District Cooling Group Berhad
overview: 2026年公司完成凭单派发及员工购股权计划，但公告中未披露各业务板块的扩张、缩减或新合约信息。最新一季营收同比增长115.4%，净利润同比增长67.0%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company completed a bonus issue of warrants and an employees' share option scheme, but no announcements disclosed expansion, reduction, or new contracts for any business segment. Latest quarterly revenue grew 115.4% year-on-year and net profit grew 67.0% year-on-year.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 2026年完成凭单派发及员工购股权计划，未披露业务板块层面的具体动态。
segments.note_en: Completed bonus issue of warrants and employees' share option scheme in 2026; no segment-level business developments were disclosed.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 211,911,224张凭单于2026年8月10日完成在ACE Market上市及报价。
actions.text_en: 211,911,224 warrants were completed listing and quotation on the ACE Market on 10 August 2026.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 凭单行使价定为RM0.8200，凭单契约于2026年7月17日签署。
actions.text_en: The exercise price of the warrants was fixed at RM0.8200 and the deed poll was executed on 17 July 2026.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 员工购股权计划于2026年5月21日生效。
actions.text_en: The employees' share option scheme became effective on 21 May 2026.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: Bursa Securities于2026年2月13日批准凭单上市及员工购股权计划相关股份的上市与报价。
actions.text_en: Bursa Securities approved on 13 February 2026 the listing of warrants and the listing and quotation of shares under the employees' share option scheme.
